raw_segments.text: Queen Isabel, so happy be the issue, brother England, of this good day and of this gracious
meeting as we are now glad to behold your eyes, your eyes, which hitherto have borne
in them against the French that met them in their bent the fatal balls of murdering basilisks.
The venom of such looks, we fairly hope, have lost their quality, and that this day shall
change all griefs and quarrels into love.
